title: Agent execution result
description: Structured final answer every Claude or Codex execution must return (ARCHITECTURE.md section 7.5). Passed to the CLIs as their output schema (claude --json-schema, codex exec --output-schema) without the top-level metadata keywords, so it only uses keywords both providers' structured output supports: every property is required and nullable values use a type list. Lengths are enforced by the control plane on ingestion.

status.description: completed: the assignment is done; blocked: it cannot continue without something outside the agent's control; failed: the agent tried and could not do it.

summary.description: Short operational summary of what was done and why. Not a transcript.

commits.description: Local commit SHAs created in the workspace.
